name: Car maintenance
intro: Where trip auto-logging never drops a shift and service reminders fire, and where data vanishes when you switch phones.

apps.title: Road Trip MPG
apps.verdict: One of the best fuel and expense trackers on iOS: has been around since 2009, a responsive developer who answers email directly, no ads, no subscriptions. Downsides are data getting cut off past 3 years and iOS-only.
apps.loved: A living developer who replies fast, no ads or subscriptions, detailed expense and mileage analytics, proven across 10+ years of real use
apps.weak: Data silently truncates beyond 3 years, iPad version costs extra, cross-iPhone sync broke after an update, motorcycle support is incomplete
apps.whoFor: Drivers who want an honest expense and MPG history without ads or monthly fees

quotes.text: Avoid if you want to actually keep your data. I've been using this app for years to come back and find all my old data is gone. At some point app decided to keep only 3 years worth of data.

I've been using this app for over a decade and I find it so helpful. I started using it just to track my mileage, but soon realized that all of my automotive expenses, reminders, and notes can have a single home!

You cannot attach receipts to any purchase of parts or services. I recommended this 6 years ago and was told he hoped to add that feature in the future. It's still not here. This would make it easier to have proof when doing gas credits for taxes or selling a vehicle.

apps.title: MileIQ: Mileage Tracker & Log
apps.verdict: MileIQ accurately tracks mileage for tax reporting and has worked reliably for years, but an aggressive price jump from $60 to $140 a year with no new features is pushing loyal users to competitors.
apps.loved: Automatic trip detection, easy personal vs. business split, clean export for accountants, stable performance over multiple years
apps.weak: Price doubled from $60 to $140 a year with no added value, occasionally misses trips, support only responds through an AI bot, no automatic toll tracking
apps.whoFor: Freelancers, real estate agents, and road-heavy professionals who need clean mileage logs for taxes and are okay with the price

quotes.text: I have been using MileIQ for 8 years now. It is very user friendly and I am able to accurately keep track of my personal and business miles easily. At the end of the year I simply create my report and send it to my accountant. I highly recommend it.

apps.title: Car Cave - Car Maintenance Log
apps.verdict: A minimalist car maintenance log. Easy to get started, and the developer responds quickly to bugs, but it lacks data export and receipt uploads.
apps.loved: Clean interface, fast developer response to issues, affordable premium version
apps.weak: No record export, no receipt uploads, no back button to the main screen, service intervals cannot be set independently from dates
apps.whoFor: Drivers who want a simple oil and maintenance log without extra features

quotes.text: Great that tracking by mileage is now an option… problem is it is not independent from date. You cannot select a custom mileage interval separate from date. I cannot set my oil change to 12 months or 10k miles. Every month is tied to 1k miles.
This app is very easy to use, I have to give up SimplyAuto app due to not intuitive. I love this one but I don't like you can't upload receipts.

apps.title: AUTOsist Fleet Management App
apps.verdict: A maintenance log for multiple vehicles with receipt photo attachments. Strong on support and long-term record storage, weak on rigid pricing and login issues.
apps.loved: Stores years of service history with attached receipt photos, convenient for owners of multiple vehicles
apps.weak: Occasional login problems, one-vehicle limit on the free tier, upgrading from personal to fleet plan jumps to $100 per month with nothing in between
apps.whoFor: Responsible owners of multiple vehicles who want a complete service history

quotes.text: I've been using this app for 8 years to track all maintenance related expenses on my personal vehicle. I love how easy it is to use and to stay organized, and the simplicity of attaching a picture of the receipt to each log I make.
I have three vintage Mercedes and a Porsche Cayenne. Coming from the airline world, I am a stickler about maintenance records. Autoist is the perfect digital companion to hardcopy records.

It's a nice app that does just what I needed. I only wish I could add more vehicles. I have motorcycles, ATV's, and such that I'd like to track and would gladly pay, but it goes from 5 at a very reasonable price to $100 per month to track a fleet. Uhh, no. Can I just pay $40 for 10 vehicles?

I've been using this app for 8 years to track all maintenance related expenses on my personal vehicle. I love the simplicity of attaching a picture of the receipt to each log I make. I pull up past receipts and odometer readings to gauge when something needs to be done.
Uploaded images of receipts are very poor. They are clearly reduced once the upload has been completed. This was a serious downfall.

apps.title: Mileage Tracker by Everlance
apps.verdict: An automatic mileage tracker for self-employed workers and couriers with tax reporting. Runs in the background and saves time at tax time, but a persistent banner blocks GPS and there are transaction bugs.
apps.loved: Automatic trip tracking, tax export, bank card integration, saves real money on deductions
apps.weak: Banner covers navigation while driving, no undo button, duplicate trips, bank linking issues, account deletion is difficult
apps.whoFor: Couriers, freelancers, and gig workers who need automatic mileage tracking for taxes

quotes.text: When selecting multiple items when classifying you have to be very careful selecting the trip or it will open the trip. When filtering and selecting all to mass classify it selects all the trips you have unclassified. Not just the filtered trips.

apps.title: Mileage Tracker by Driversnote
apps.verdict: A solid automatic mileage tracker with years of stable operation, a clean interface, and reliable trip detection, but a 15-trip monthly free limit and $11-13 per month for full access turns many people away.
apps.loved: Starts automatically when you drive, stores years of history, clean tax reporting, responsive support
apps.weak: Hard 15-trip limit with no warning, high subscription price, sometimes fails to end a trip when stopping at a gas station, export occasionally crashes
apps.whoFor: Drivers with a small number of business trips per month or those willing to pay for reliable auto-tracking

quotes.text: I drive A LOT for someone who is not a trucker. I have driven about 70,000 miles since downloading this app, then purchasing the motion-sensing device that auto-tracks trips. I learned the hard way that, even though my iPhone is less than 15" away from the "bug," it does not always automatically track trips.
The app uses a huge amount of battery life and unless you keep it "always on" instead of "only when using," it won't track your mileage and trips.

apps.title: ZUS - Save Car Expenses
apps.verdict: ZUS is an OBD2 device with an ecosystem: mileage tracking, code diagnostics, tire pressure monitoring, HUD, and a trip rewards program. The feature set is wide and impressive when stable. Weak points are unreliable code reading on some vehicles and iOS compatibility breaking after major OS updates.
apps.loved: Wide feature set in one device: OBD2 codes, tire pressure via add-on sensor, HUD, mileage tracking, and small trip rewards
apps.weak: Misses real error codes on some vehicles (Chrysler cited), features temporarily break after iOS updates, rewards program is inconsistent
apps.whoFor: Car owners who want an all-in-one gadget for basic diagnostics and monitoring without expecting professional-grade accuracy

quotes.text: I drive a 2016 Chrysler. Not a very old car and not an obscure make. It has been throwing three codes that a cheaper OBDII scanner easily picks up and the check engine light has been on for months. Their app claims there are no codes and no CEL.

apps.title: Fuel MPG Calculator
apps.verdict: A fuel consumption tracker with fillup and service history. The core is reliable, but a version 3.0 update wiped years of data for many users.
apps.loved: Free app with no ads, data stored in the phone's backup, developer personally helped users recover corrupted records
apps.weak: The 3.0 update broke measurement units and destroyed 4-6 years of data for many users
apps.whoFor: Drivers who keep a long-term fillup and fuel consumption log

quotes.text: Love this app, but the revamp caused my mileage from the last 6 years to convert to kilometers. When I switched back to miles, about 35,000 miles were missing. I share this data with my mechanic and now it's all screwed up!

apps.title: Mileage Tracker App by TripLog
apps.verdict: TripLog is a mature mileage tracker with tax-ready reports, flexible modes, and automatic monthly summaries. Works reliably in manual mode. The main problem is that the BT beacon auto-tracking misses trips inconsistently, and users only find out at the end of the month.
apps.loved: Flexible tracking modes, automatic monthly report, support for multiple businesses in one account
apps.weak: BT beacon silently skips trips, settings reset after updates and months of data are lost, annual report was removed and is now monthly only
apps.whoFor: Self-employed workers and landlords who log mileage manually or by schedule and need clean tax exports

quotes.text: The 3 Star overall is because of the inconsistent trip auto-start feature that is supposed to engage with the USB Bluetooth chip that's plugged in your vehicle's USB port. This past week it stopped recognizing my vehicle beacon and I missed two days of tracking.

I've been using this app for 5 years now for my taxes. Super easy to use to send to my accountant and to my email for the year-end tax report. However, lately, they don't let you send the whole year's report, instead, month by month. Kinda hassle to keep going back month to month record.

This app is super easy to use and works very well to set up everything that you need. It sends you a report automatically at the end of the month so you don't have to think about it. Then at the end of the year, everything is just there and ready to handover to your tax person!

This is the second time an update has required me to re-login and all the settings have to be reset so it will start logging trips again. This time I have lost two months of trips and honestly, it would be so much better if the updates would not interfere with login capabilities.

apps.title: Mileage Tracker by MileageWise
apps.verdict: A mileage tracker for tax reporting with automatic trip logging and report export, but the auto-tracking is unreliable (misses up to a third of the route), CarPlay is incompatible, and support refuses refunds.
apps.loved: Automatic logging with no manual start, Google Maps integration, clean ad-free interface, useful for gig workers at tax time
apps.weak: Misses up to 50% of trips, incompatible with CarPlay, duplicates addresses with different abbreviations, support refuses refunds for broken tracking
apps.whoFor: Freelancers and couriers tracking mileage for tax deductions who are willing to fill in missed trips manually

quotes.text: Battery and data usage are minimal, and I love that it's completely ad-free.

apps.title: My Car - Vehicle Manager
apps.verdict: A clean multi-vehicle maintenance log with reminders and a web version, but the free tier is heavily restricted and the paid version is locked behind a subscription instead of a one-time purchase.
apps.loved: Clean design, multiple vehicle support, custom reminders, web sync, fuel consumption reports
apps.weak: Free tier limits are hidden until after you enter data, deletes a car without confirmation when adding a new one, web sync breaks for some subscribers
apps.whoFor: Owners of 2-4 vehicles who want one clean log and are willing to pay around $2 a month

apps.title: Fuel Monitor Pro
apps.verdict: A mature multi-vehicle expense and fuel tracker with service interval tracking, but the monetization model changed and users now hit record limits or lose access to old data.
apps.loved: Works reliably over 4-8 years, accurate real fuel consumption vs. car display, combined time-and-mileage service reminders
apps.weak: Record limit blocks without warning, Pro version migration breaks, data export requires a separate purchase, EV import does not work
apps.whoFor: Owners of multiple vehicles who care about years of expense history and service intervals

quotes.text: Been using for 8 years or so… best part is keeping track of MPG and enter services like oil changes, etc. Since it has both time and distance, can set oil changes for 12 months or 12k miles, which ever comes first.

apps.title: Gridwise: Gig Driver Assistant
apps.verdict: An earnings and mileage aggregator for gig drivers with convenient tax reporting, but mileage tracking fails regularly, and market analytics are tied to large cities and often useless in smaller ones.
apps.loved: Auto-pulls earnings from multiple platforms, easy tax export, airport stats help rideshare drivers
apps.weak: Mileage tracking is unstable, price jumped to $108 per year, ads appeared even for paying subscribers, market insights only work in large cities
apps.whoFor: Uber and Lyft drivers in large cities who want a single earnings and mileage dashboard

quotes.text: I really love this app and it tracks my mileage great. But why can you not see your personal mileage total? You can easily see your business miles total, but when doing taxes it also asks your personal miles.

apps.title: Hurdlr Mileage, Expenses & Tax
apps.verdict: Hurdlr is a multi-tool for freelancers combining mileage, expenses, and taxes in one place. A plus for couriers and real estate agents. The downside is bank connections drop constantly and the tracker splits one trip into dozens of segments at every stop.
apps.loved: Combines mileage, income, and expenses in one interface, simplifies tax prep
apps.weak: Bank disconnects repeatedly and creates duplicate transactions, tracker chops every trip into fragments at each stoplight
apps.whoFor: Couriers and self-employed workers who want a single mileage and expense log and can tolerate bank sync failures

quotes.text: This used to be a great app. Now, it starts a new trip if I'm at a light too long, if I go through a drive through. I hate it. Looking for something else.

apps.title: Pure Gas
apps.verdict: The only widely available ethanol-free gas station finder in the US, useful for classics and motorcycles, but the database goes stale and the developer is nearly unreachable.
apps.loved: Finds ethanol-free gas where you cannot find it otherwise, simple to use, volunteer project with no monetization
apps.weak: Map listings do not stay current and some stations have closed, no octane rating filter, search is limited to a 30-40 mile radius, data entry is broken after an update (cannot enter decimals)
apps.whoFor: Owners of classic cars, motorcycles, and aircraft who need gas without ethanol

quotes.text: Great app. My 1970 Mustang 392 4V runs much better on non-ethanol and now I can easily locate it with this app. Noticed an improvement in idle, lower engine temp, smell, and less exhaust gunk once I got off of E10.

apps.title: Mileage Expense Log & Tracker
apps.verdict: A simple business mileage log that handles basic tasks but loses data during phone transfers, shows ads after updates, has outdated mileage rates with no way to edit them manually.
apps.loved: Fast data entry, Dropbox export, Apple Watch support, trip categories for tax reporting
apps.weak: Data lost when switching phones, ads appear without notice, IRS rates are not updated, auto-tracking only works when started manually
apps.whoFor: Freelancers who need a basic business trip log for taxes without complex features

apps.title: Fuelly: MPG & Service Tracker
apps.verdict: A ten-year veteran for tracking fuel and service work, functional and free, but the iOS app lags well behind Android in features and has not been updated in over a year.
apps.loved: Simple fillup and service entry, cross-device sync, free core, large vehicle database, compare fuel economy with other users
apps.weak: iOS version has fewer stats and charts than Android, no updates in over a year, periodically logs you out, stations disappear from the database, cannot insert a missed fillup without a cascading recalculation
apps.whoFor: Budget-conscious drivers who want to track fuel economy and service history without spending money

quotes.text: Changing my rating to 1 star because you cannot add a missed fuelup without deleting all of the fuelups after it. The "Last odometer" field is autofilled and you cannot change it manually. Therefore the mileage calculation will be WRONG.

apps.title: Mileage Tracker by Psngr
apps.verdict: A mileage tracker with automatic trip recording. Plus: no need to press buttons. Minus: frequent failures after updates and missed trips.
apps.loved: Automatic trip capture with no manual start
apps.weak: App crashed after several consecutive updates, walking was logged as driving trips, some trips disappeared entirely
apps.whoFor: Freelancers and employees who need a log for tax deductions and can accept instability

apps.title: CarScope: Car Management & MPG
apps.verdict: A feature-rich fuel and expense tracker with solid analytics, but recurring sync issues, disappearing records, and aggressive plan changes without notice undermine trust.
apps.loved: Rich analytics, receipt photo storage, multiple vehicle support, works for Uber and Lyft drivers
apps.weak: Fuel entries stop saving without warning, data disappears during transfers, subscription changes without notification, support goes silent
apps.whoFor: Gig workers with multiple vehicles who can tolerate unreliable sync in exchange for detailed analytics

apps.title: CARFAX Car Care
apps.verdict: CARFAX Car Care is valuable as a service history repository and recall checker, but unstable behavior after every update and unreliable record saving undermine trust in a tool where accuracy is critical.
apps.loved: Service history tracking for multiple vehicles, open recall notifications, ability to store receipts and avoid unnecessary service (one user example: $800 saved on transmission fluid)
apps.weak: After every major update the app freezes on the splash screen for weeks, new records often fail to save, odometer shows incorrect values, the same record gets duplicated eight times
apps.whoFor: Owners of multiple vehicles who care about service history and are willing to tolerate post-update instability

quotes.text: I thought I needed to change my transmission fluid (on a Mercedes) because I bought the car used. I downloaded the app and it let me know exactly when it was changed and saved me $800.

I do really love the way this app works. It has allowed me to keep track of a lot of things I used to forget about. Only reason I can't give it five stars is because I wish there was a way to add more slots. I manage my employer's family vehicles.

I've had this app for over 5 years. These past few months I've been unable to launch the app. It hangs on the splash screen then quits. I am on an iPhone 13S. I have not been able to log on for months.

apps.title: FIXD OBD2 Scanner
apps.verdict: An OBD2 scanner with plain-language error code explanations and severity ratings, but the subscription flow is designed so users accidentally agree to a $100-per-year charge without a clear warning.
apps.loved: Reads error codes and explains them in plain language, shows estimated repair costs, helps when buying a used car, live engine data
apps.weak: Hidden $99-106 per year auto-subscription, children can accidentally enable paid access, difficult cancellation, 2FA required on every connection, mileage prediction outputs random numbers
apps.whoFor: Car owners who read the fine print carefully and want to understand error codes without going to a shop

quotes.text: The best thing for me is how it tells you how serious a problem is and if it's okay to keep driving or not. I also like the live data stuff and how it explains codes in a way that actually makes sense. Being able to clear codes is nice too.

Did you enter your mileage manually? Sucks, this app will decide to spit out randomly generated fugazi mileage numbers for no reason. I constantly go on the app and see added miles to my vehicles that I never drove. This stupid predictive daily mileage algorithm is broken.

apps.title: Carly — OBD2 car scanner
apps.verdict: Carly is an OBD2 scanner with deep BMW support: coding, full module diagnostics, and solid code descriptions. Works well for BMW owners. For other brands the feature set is much thinner, and an auto-renewing subscription you can only cancel through support generates consistent frustration.
apps.loved: For BMW: deep coding, all-module support, clear error descriptions, responsive support for hardware problems
apps.weak: Subscription auto-renews without a reminder, can only be cancelled through support, limited functionality for non-BMW vehicles
apps.whoFor: BMW owners who want to diagnose and code their car themselves without going to a dealer

quotes.text: Worked for my BMW 128 (12V battery change) but barely works for a Lexus LX470. Do not buy for anything other than a BMW. I can't even read basic OBD codes for the Lexus.

apps.title: Simple Mileage Tracker
apps.verdict: An automatic mileage tracker for business deductions with a clean interface, but unreliable background tracking regularly misses trips and support takes weeks to respond.
apps.loved: Clean interface, one-tap reports, automatic personal vs. business trip split with no manual start
apps.weak: Misses trips when the app is closed, splits one trip into multiple legs at stoplights, outdated IRS rates, support goes silent for weeks, cannot change the account email
apps.whoFor: Freelancers and small businesses who want polished mileage reports for taxes and are willing to manually verify missed trips

quotes.text: Just downloaded the app and started using it only to find out the mileage rate being used is from 2022. Paying a monthly fee you would think the app should be current with the published IRS rates.

apps.title: Fleetio Go - Fleet Management
apps.verdict: An enterprise fleet management system for drivers who have it mandated by their employer: inspections, photo documentation, and mileage logging work, but the app crashes when switching networks and requires a manual password on every login.
apps.loved: Vehicle inspections with photos, trip tracking, digital forms replacing paperwork
apps.weak: Crashes when switching from WiFi to cellular, no Face ID or Touch ID, cannot upload saved photos, crashes when opening the parts catalog, support does not respond
apps.whoFor: Corporate fleet drivers whose company uses Fleetio as its fleet management platform

quotes.text: Our drivers use tablets that connect to Wi-Fi in the vehicle and the tablets flip to cellular network outside the vehicle. The network flips cause inspections to reset. It will be very helpful to make sure a started inspection can persist through these network switches.

apps.title: Motus - Business Mileage Log
apps.verdict: Motus is a corporate mileage reimbursement tracker. When running in Power Supply Only mode, tracking is stable. The main problem is that the app automatically logs users out without notice, losing weeks of mileage data.
apps.loved: Automatic GPS mileage tracking, simple monthly report submission
apps.weak: Spontaneous automatic logouts with no notification cause data loss, requires constant location access which bothers users on personal phones
apps.whoFor: Employees at companies that require Motus for corporate mileage reimbursement

quotes.text: This app works well without any battery consequence as long as I have it set to track in "Power Supply Only" mode. Then it only seems to run the GPS and try to track mileage while it's plugged in to power in the car.
The only problem I think Motus has is using user location all the time. It won't work when you put it on use location when using the app. That's a big issue to think and it kills my phone battery.

At least once a month I will get logged out automatically and no notification about it and have to review notes and memory to input the stops. No point in using this as you'll still have to keep a written log of where you go on a daily basis.

apps.title: Vehicle Maintenance Tracker
apps.verdict: A simple multi-vehicle maintenance log with photos and reminders, but one update reset dates for thousands of users and trust in data integrity is damaged.
apps.loved: Free core version, multiple vehicle support, photos attached to records, complete service history in one place
apps.weak: Mass date reset to 01/01/1900 after an update with no warning, crashes when opening settings, photos disappear, no cloud backup in the free version
apps.whoFor: Anyone who wants a simple free log and accepts the risk of data loss on major updates

quotes.text: Last app update I lost all the dates of service for all cars in the app. VERY DISAPPOINTING. Tell us we will lose it if we don't upgrade. Just a money grab.

apps.title: Auto Care Kit
apps.verdict: A multi-vehicle maintenance log with a clean interface but catastrophically unreliable cloud backup: data regularly disappears after updates and device changes.
apps.loved: Easy to add multiple vehicles, export in multiple formats, intuitive interface
apps.weak: Cloud sync wipes data after updates, no custom service categories, ads cannot be turned off, adding a fourth vehicle fails
apps.whoFor: Anyone managing multiple vehicles who accepts the risk of losing service history on updates

quotes.text: I've lost all of my data. Everything going back since 2019 on my car as well as records on two other cars are completely gone. Either a recent update wiped it or updating to a new phone did. I've had it synced to my Gmail account since I started using this app many years ago and all my data is gone.
Had this app for nearly a year. Very simple, easy to use for keeping track of every little (or big) thing you do to a vehicle. Problem is when I went to add a 4th vehicle it won't "add".

apps.title: Simply Auto: Mileage Tracker
apps.verdict: Once a solid mileage and expense tracker, but development has been abandoned: Google Drive backup has been broken since early 2025, the app crashes on iOS 18, and paid subscriptions cannot be restored.
apps.loved: One-time payment instead of a subscription, multiple vehicle support, truck drivers praise the simplicity
apps.weak: Google Drive backup broken since January 2025, crashes on iOS 18, developer support unavailable, data lost when switching phones
apps.whoFor: No current recommendation as the app has effectively been abandoned

quotes.text: Manual backup/restore to Google Drive no longer works because of security requirements Google put in place in January 2025. With no current development for the app, this is very unlikely to be fixed. Time to find another app.

apps.title: MileKeeper: Mileage Tracker AI
apps.verdict: A mileage tracker with auto-logging and tax reports. Real reviews report disappearing trips and data being locked behind a paywall without warning.
apps.loved: Automatic trip tracking and annual tax reports
apps.weak: Trips disappear, accumulated data gets locked behind a paywall without warning, entry price is $69.99
apps.whoFor: Worth trying for curious users, but check the data retention policy before paying

apps.title: Stride: Mileage & Tax Tracker
apps.verdict: Stride is free and simple, but suffers from a critical bug: mileage disappears after several hours of driving, which is especially painful for Uber and Lyft drivers who lose hundreds of dollars in tax deductions.
apps.loved: Free, simple interface, built-in expense tracking, convenient for gig workers when it works
apps.weak: Mileage disappears after 4-8 hours of driving with no warning, auto-tracking often stops on its own, no DoorDash Crimson card integration, aggressive notifications that cannot be disabled without losing functionality
apps.whoFor: Gig workers with short shifts who check the app regularly. Long shifts without monitoring risk a full data wipe.

quotes.text: I've been using the Stride app since 2020. I think it's a great app, but this year, 2026, I'll turn the app on before I go out to work and by the time I get home, anywhere from 4 to 6 hours later, when I look at my mileage it's at ZERO or barely even a couple miles recorded.

apps.title: Fuel Tracker Gas & Mileage Log
apps.verdict: A simple fillup tracker with flexible unit support, but without reliable cloud backup data is regularly lost when upgrading a phone, and the MPG formula produces errors.
apps.loved: Supports mixed units (odometer in km, fuel in gallons), clean interface, no ads in the paid version
apps.weak: Data lost when switching devices even in the Pro version, MPG formula gives incorrect values, white text on white input field makes the app unusable
apps.whoFor: Owners of imported vehicles with non-standard units who are willing to maintain manual backups

quotes.text: I love the function of this app but hate that every time I upgrade my phone all my data is lost, even with the pro version.

apps.title: Truck & RV Fuel Stations
apps.verdict: A directory of truck and RV fuel stations for long US road trips, useful for Flying J and Loves fans, but the database has not been updated in a long time and misses about half of the real chains.
apps.loved: Finds fuel stops with RV lanes and propane where Google Maps falls short, works well alongside other road trip apps
apps.weak: No fuel prices, missing Kwik Trip, BP, Exxon, Sheetz, and Buc-ee's, filters do not affect the map, no user-submitted locations
apps.whoFor: RV travelers in the US who stick to Flying J and Loves and know about the database limitations

apps.title: Track My Mileage
apps.verdict: A mileage tracker with basic features but aggressive monetization: the free version is nearly fully locked, and entering a card triggers attempted unauthorized charges.
apps.loved: Trip copy feature for recurring routes, fast support response on real bug reports
apps.weak: Attempted unauthorized $39.95 charge for a music add-on during card verification, GPS and export are paywalled, the copy feature is broken and copies the wrong trip, data disappears
apps.whoFor: Not recommended to anyone in its current state due to monetization issues

apps.title: Mile Logger - Mileage tracker
apps.verdict: A free background mileage tracker for tax deductions, but over the past year it regularly loses trips, crashes on export, and covers the interface with intrusive ads.
apps.loved: Runs in the background with no manual start, distinguishes personal and business trips, genuinely free
apps.weak: Drops entire weeks of trips, CSV export crashes, ads block the category switcher, no backup so history is gone when you change phones
apps.whoFor: Anyone willing to accept instability in exchange for a zero cost and who does not store data beyond a season

quotes.text: It logs all the trips but it won't export. Every time I go to export the app crashes. Is there a way to fix this?

apps.title: MisMar مسمار
apps.verdict: A Saudi Arabia aggregator for mobile auto service and car washes. Convenient in theory, but in practice coordination between operators is chaotic, repairs stretch from 4 days to 3 months, and refunds for cancelled services are refused.
apps.loved: Easy online booking, mobile mechanic service at your location, photo documentation of work at some shops
apps.weak: Different operators give contradictory information, repairs drag from 4 days to 3 months, no refunds for purchased packages when cancelled, PPF and coatings were damaged during washing
apps.whoFor: Saudi Arabia users with small non-urgent tasks like a car wash or routine service who can accept delays

apps.title: Treads App
apps.verdict: A subscription mobile tire installation service, not a maintenance tracker. Since mid-2025 the company has stopped responding to users while continuing to charge subscriptions.
apps.loved: When operational: fast on-site tire installation at the customer's location, good support
apps.weak: Company has effectively shut down: tire technicians do not show up, emergency service does not answer, subscription cannot be cancelled and charges keep coming
apps.whoFor: Not recommended in its current state

scenarios.name: Gig drivers
scenarios.job: Automatically log every business trip during a shift and get a tax-ready report with no manual entry

scenarios.name: Small businesses and the self-employed
scenarios.job: Track business trips across several clients or properties and export a report to the accountant at the end of the month

scenarios.name: Enthusiasts and multi-car owners
scenarios.job: Keep a complete service log for several cars with history, receipt photos, and reminders for the next service

scenarios.name: Frugal drivers and classic car owners
scenarios.job: Track real fuel consumption and find the right gas for a specific car
